problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a technician to inspect twelve regional facilities:
Facility Alpha: Positioned at grid reference (66,88)
Facility Beta: Positioned at grid reference (171,41)
Facility Gamma: Positioned at grid reference (78,4)
Facility Delta: Positioned at grid reference (91,146)
Facility Epsilon: Positioned at grid reference (138,14)

Facility Lambda: Positioned at grid reference (11,3)
Facility Mu: Positioned at grid reference (57,167)

No direct service route connects Facility Alpha and Facility Beta.
Furthermore, the inspection circuit must incorporate precisely one of the following two critical pathways: the connection between Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit that visits each facility exactly once and concludes at the initial facility.
